standfirst: This issue covers OpenAI's GPT-6.2 launch and its run of ChatGPT data and sales plugins, plus Claude's new whiteboards and tools you can try this afternoon.
digest: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on Tuesday, then spent the week on ChatGPT plugins for sales and data work, including a Data agent that builds dashboards and shared reports. Claude Code 2.1.329 added warnings about where hooks come from, and Google put Tool Retrieval in preview in the Gemini API.

For a consultant, the Data plugin videos are the best five minutes of the week: they show a team going from a spreadsheet to a shared dashboard without an engineer. Clients on ChatGPT may ask about the sales and healthcare plugins, and legal clients about Astra for Law.

Anthropic's Nasdaq debut is the big story clients are likely to mention, and Reuters has the overview. To try something this afternoon, MarkItDown turns office documents into text for AI tools, and diagram-design makes clean process diagrams in Claude Code.

items.title: ChatGPT walkthrough: build and share a dashboard from sales data
items.summary: Turns a quarterly sales analysis into a shareable dashboard with annotations and refreshes. Easy to follow with your own spreadsheet.

items.title: ChatGPT walkthrough: ask what changed in your sales data
items.summary: Compares quarterly sales, shows which customer segments moved and lets you check the sources behind each answer. Useful prep for client meetings.

items.title: Workspace admins can connect team data and MCP servers to ChatGPT
items.summary: Covers enabling the Data plugin, choosing who can install it and a Snowflake example. Aimed at admins, so expect to involve IT.

items.title: A quick tour of the new Data agent in ChatGPT
items.summary: Short intro to asking questions, building charts and sharing reports, plus built-in skills for data quality and KPIs. Good first watch before the longer demos.

items.title: Turn a sales analysis into a shared report in ChatGPT Space
items.summary: Builds a page your team can read, comment on and question, with access controls and a meeting link. No setup beyond a ChatGPT workspace.

items.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Sales with 30+ partner plugins
items.summary: Demo of call prep, tailored proposals and faster follow-ups using your CRM and sales tools. Relevant if clients run sales teams on ChatGPT.

items.title: Claude's new whiteboards, sheets and data features, tested
items.summary: A hands-on look at which of the new features are useful and whether they justify leaving Google Sheets. Worth watching before you recommend them.

items.title: Claude can now turn ideas into visual whiteboards
items.summary: Short clip on turning a rough idea into a diagram inside Claude. Quick to watch, and handy for sketching a client workflow.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol across ChatGPT and the API
items.summary: Astra targets hard projects and Sol everyday work, both using fewer tokens at lower cost. Clients on ChatGPT Work or Codex will ask.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.329 adds hook warnings and a fuller task list
items.summary: Warns you where a folder's hooks come from and lists scheduled tasks in /tasks. Routine update; worth it for teams managing settings centrally.

items.title: Gemini API adds Tool Retrieval so agents can use hundreds of tools
items.summary: Now in preview, it lets agents choose from many tools while spending fewer tokens. A builder feature, so mention it to technical teams.

items.title: Astra for Law tops a 24-area legal evaluation
items.summary: OpenAI says it ranked first across 24 areas of law, and ChatGPT Enterprise customers can request access. Relevant for legal clients.

items.title: Tasks in Gemini becomes free in six countries
items.summary: Adds new features in the U.S. and deeper Google Workspace integration so Gemini can act on your behalf. Check whether your region is covered.

items.title: ChatGPT for Healthcare adds computer-use agents and new plugins
items.summary: Agents can work across healthcare software, with better clinical answers. Relevant for health clients, though regulated settings need a careful rollout.

sections.title: Tools and skills you can use

items.title: MarkItDown converts office documents to Markdown for AI tools
items.summary: Microsoft's tool turns office documents into clean text that Claude or ChatGPT can read. It runs from the command line, so expect some setup.

items.title: last30days skill researches a topic across Reddit, X, YouTube and the web
items.summary: Pulls recent discussion from several sources and writes a grounded summary. Handy for client research before a meeting, if you use Claude Code.

items.title: diagram-design gives coding agents 45 editorial diagram types
items.summary: Produces clean, self-contained HTML and SVG diagrams in Claude Code and similar tools, without Mermaid. Good for client process maps.

items.title: Academic research skills run Claude Code from research to final draft
items.summary: A skill set covering research, writing, review and revision. Useful for long reports, though it assumes you are comfortable in Claude Code.

items.title: Anthropic's docx, pptx and xlsx skills get fixes
items.summary: A commit fixes unpacking and validation in the skills that create Word, PowerPoint and Excel files. Worth pulling if you use them in Claude Code.

items.title: AutoClip cuts long videos into short clips with captions and covers
items.summary: An open source desktop app that turns podcasts and interviews into short videos with subtitles and publish copy. Check the setup requirements first.

items.title: Reuters covers Anthropic's Nasdaq debut
items.summary: Reuters on the listing, which drew 2,065 Hacker News comments. Clients may raise it, so skim the framing before they do.

items.title: Claude solves two open problems in black hole physics, Anthropic says
items.summary: Anthropic's account of Claude tackling research-level physics, with a busy Hacker News thread. A concrete example when clients ask what models can do.

items.title: Revolut cut coding time 30 to 60 percent with OpenAI and Codex
items.summary: A vendor customer story on code review, financial crime investigations and security. Figures are self-reported, but it shows where a large firm applied Codex.

items.title: Shield's agents take over legacy portal work for IT technicians
items.summary: A vendor customer story where agents navigate old systems and technicians handle the issues that need judgment. A pattern worth borrowing for IT clients.
